reviews.text: Becca was really helpful!
I have a very stubborn Basenji and his progress in just 3 weeks with Rebecca is night and day. I definitely wish I would’ve done this when he was younger, but well worth the price.

I adopted a super sweet but anxious and reactive pit/lab mix. She's 1 and i'm her 5th owner not because she's a bad dog but just because she needed some time, patience, lots of love and help with manners.

These trainers really love what they do and it shows! After 3 sessions Juna was pretty much a completely different dog!! I'm so grateful to Becca for her patience, knowledge amd kindness throughout our sessions. 1000% worth the investment

We had an amazing experience with TipTop K9 and couldn’t be happier with the training Frankie received! He went through training specifically for his reactivity, and the difference was incredible.

When we picked Frankie up, it honestly felt like we were bringing home a completely different dog. He was able to be around other dogs without freaking out, and he didn’t growl at people, dogs, or things around him like he had before. Seeing him calm and confident in situations that used to be difficult for him was amazing.

He also learned “place” extremely well, and his heel was absolutely amazing. The training gave us skills and structure that we can continue using with him at home.

We are so impressed with the work TipTop K9 put into Frankie and the results we saw. We’re incredibly grateful and would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for quality dog training, especially for a reactive dog. Thank you, TipTop K9, for helping Frankie become the best version of himself!
Rebecca was an amazing trainer to my puppy Jaxon.  He so excited to see her.  I highly recommend Tip Top K9 for training.

Tip Top worked with our chocolate Lab Sadie for about a month and she’s already much more calm and responsive one day one back at home.  Tip Top will continue to work with us as long as we need.  Highly recommended these folks for your dog training needs.   Big kudos to Cameron & Becca in particular.
Becca was our trainer and she was extremely helpful and explained everything.  Both my husband and I were very impressed with her knowledge.
My dog had 3 sessions and I can tell the difference. I’m very happy with the results. Becca is great, very nice person and great on her job as well. I’m very happy with the service!

Our dog Bimo is currently enrolled in the Hybrid training program. He came back from the initial intensive training with immediately noticeable changes for the better.  We are in the middle of private training now and he’s been getting better every week! I would recommend Tip Top K9 to anyone looking for fast results for their pup.

Poppy did so good! She is a stubborn girl but she did so good and it’s been so helpful to know what to do outside of training!

Becca was amazing and can really tell she loves dogs and what she does!
I had a wonderful experience with Top Top K9 dog trainers. They work with you and your dog to a degree to make sure you and your dog understand the commands. Great team of folks.

The training was way too expensive! We paid $1,740 for five lessons, but we didn’t achieve all of our top three goals. Additionally, we can’t attend the free unlimited dog classes because our dog can’t be around other dogs. This makes the more expensive package that includes those free group classes pointless.

Our main goals were to prevent him from jumping on people, have him listen when we tell him to stop, and to be able to take him for walks. While he has successfully learned not to jump on people and to come when called, we still can’t take him for walks because he loses control around other animals. Although the trainer was great during our lessons, the number of sessions was very limited, and in my opinion, the cost just isn’t worth the outcome.

The two goals we did manage to achieve he learned quickly, which I understand are fundamental. However, I now need to find another service to fill the gaps, which will double our expenses.

Tigger recently completed a board and train with Tip Top K9 and I could not be happier with the results! Mercedes was wonderful to work with and made me feel confident during our initial visit. I also appreciated how easy it was to book and the communication the whole time Tigger was away.

Since coming home, Tigger is doing so much better on walks, and his recall has been incredibly impressive. I can really see the progress he made, and it has made such a difference! I’m so grateful for the care, patience, and training Mercedes put into helping Tigger succeed. Highly recommend!

Mercedes and the gang have been instrumental in my pup’s training. I highly recommend Tip Top K9 Training! I did the board and train program because that was the best option for me and my pup. The group classes have been essential to me. I feel like I learn more about training my dog than she learns. No dog is too old. Mine was 5 when she did training and probably the most stubborn dog I’ve met. They teach you how to work through the stubbornness. I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

Kris has helped me and Daffodil so much. I would highly recommend him to anyone who has an agressive dog.
My dog has totally change alot
I love the new dog that she has become
Thank you Kris for all of your help. You are the best.
Mercedes made it possible for my dog to be in public without being a menace. A world of difference and I am most grateful. Thank you!

Tip Top was a game changer!! Our jumpy, leash pulling dog has turned into an angel. Samuel, our trainer, was great and so sweet to our girl. Chris was patient and taught us how to issue commands and how to understand our dog and reinforce her training. Would recommend to anyone needing help with getting their dog to behave to their full potential.

We recently adopted a 1.5 year old Golden Retriever who had some frustrating but typical puppy behaviors. We decided to send him to the Tip Top K9 bootcamp and we are very pleased with the results. We have two young children and he will be able to become part of our family so much faster with the skills he learned. He is a very strong willed pup so I truly don’t think the training would have been as effective without the e collar.

This team LOVES DOGS!!! My wife and I had a reactive and isolated dog; we’ve been able to go on walks as a family for the first time!!!

Every trainer at TipTop wants me to be successful and patiently works us through this awesome program. I only wish we’d have found them sooner.

I have a miniature dachshund doc that will be 2 this year. His name is Neo Solstice. I was having issues with Neo pulling while we were walking, not listening to commands (quiet, come, sit, place, etc.) and his erratic behavior when new people came over, door bell rings, or just seeing people or other dogs in public.
I found Tip Top K9 on a google search and saw they had pretty good reviews! I called Tip Top K9 just to see what it was about and everyone was so nice and helpful.
I had Chris as my trainer and he was very good at his job. He was very straight forward and would alway describe the best way to train them. If you were not completely getting it he would slow it down for you. This training helped a lot with Neo! He walks so much better than he used to, he has stopped barking, mostly, and he listens to my commands now. This is of course is still a work in progress. I am very happy with the results and I would recommend if you are having any issues with your dog and you want some help call Tip Top K9! They will absolutely help you through it!

Mercedes was absolutely fantastic, and did an amazing job with our 2 year old rescue. We had been trying to train him on our own after adoption with no success, and had tried a few sessions with other trainers that weren't a good fit. Her techniques have made a massive difference in reducing his reactive tendencies, and his behavior and walk ability have changed drastically.
We loved TTK9! The trainers are very knowledgeable and make the whole process fun and positive. Thanks, Kris!

My dog Thatcher and I had such a positive experience working with Mercedes. We have made significant progress just in the 3 weeks we’ve been working with her. Very impressed and so glad we invested with Tip Top K9.

Kris was very patient with me and Loki
We learned how to heal come sit  stop barking
And use the E remote. These were all things we needed help with.   Now I feel we are in control and can progress from here by continuing practice and going to continuing classes.  I highly recommend Kris and Tip Top K9

Kris helped William so much over such a short amount of time. We had previously had William trained but it hadn’t stuck because we didn’t have the tools to maintain. Kris taught William and us how to use the tools to have him listen every time. William is so much better behaved and is consistent with doing what he’s asked, even months later.
I can’t believe William has learned so much! It was hard being away from him for 3 weeks, but he came back a brand new dog, and I’m actually excited to take him for walks now that he heels!

This has to be one of the best experiences that I did not regret.
Ar first, my family and I were conflicted on whom to choose, but once the lessons started, we were very pleased by the results. Everything Merecedez (our awesome trainer!!!) has done a lot of the work and helped us understand how to train our doggies too! We got to learn "come", "off", "quiet", "heel", and "place", which were all very significant.
If you want to train your dogs and have a positive outcome and results, come over to TTK9 to help you!

Hey! I couldn't recommend them enough, they are amazing and Maverick came home happy and ready to show off everything he learned. I looked at a few places when considering where to take my pitbull for training. And start to finish they have kept me updated and even sent me additional photos of his progress.
One thing that stood out for me was that they guaranteed his understanding of the commands over the timeframe of when they would have him.
10 stars on customer service and loving my boy

Kris was a fantastic help in teaching our Aussie all the basic and intermediate commands, and she’s almost like a new puppy now! Maeve is much more responsive, relaxed, and actually listens. Thanks so much, Tip Top K9!
Our puppy has thrived with tip top K9. Highly recommend!
Tip top k9 did such ana amazing job with our French bulldog Elphie. She came back the same lovable puppy but with more structure and so much more happy. I can't wait to keep training with them!

Kris was, without a doubt, the most impactful and successful dog trainer we have used. We’ve done everything from group classes, two week board & train, in-home trainings and none have been as sustainable, repeatable, and successful as our sessions with Kris. They were super flexible with our needs so we did 2 trainer/dog-only sessions followed by 3 at-home sessions with us and the dog. Could not recommend more!

They helped me so much with cardi! She was aggressive towards other dogs and I couldn’t control her. Now I can control her keep her off people and things and she’s okay with other dogs!!! I recommend tiptop k9 to everyone!!!

Mercedes was amazing! She did a wonderful job explaining all the commands and making sure we felt comfortable once our dog left his two week training. Overall a great experience from start to finish with Tip Top K9!
Mercedes did a awesome job with our puppy Susie. She was very patient and she is very knowledgeable!

Tip Top K9 has been a wonderful training experience. I have a 6 year old Great Pyrenees and am able to walk him with ease and communicate with him even though he is an older dog of a stubborn breed. He's loved all the attention and training also.

I am absolutely beyond pleased with Argos and the trainers! I am very thankful to absolutely all who helped trained my crazy boy! He is so much more calm and has made a huge change! 10/10 do recommend you will not be disappointed! The trainers are beyond friendly and have been a huge help!

Chris with Tip Top K9 was the best with our golden retriever pup! Our golden LOVED to pull on the leash when taking walks, and now walking with him is a breeze. We are so thankful for the help and continued education with Tip Top K9!
I took my golden retriever for the baseline board and train and am happy with his results and the customer experience I got!

My dog was trained in California.  I did not get the results I wanted.  I knew he needed more training.  I contacted Kris at Tip Top K9 Training and we scheduled our first meeting to show me what Tip Top could help me work with my dog.  I was very impressed with Kris I went ahead and scheduled all training appointments needed for TC.  We have just completed our 4th training session with Mercedes, who is very compent and skilled in her profession, and it amazes me how well TC is doing. She's kind and gentle and have helped us work all aspects in TC's training.  Thank you Kris & Mercedes for all the kindness you have shown, with awesome results.
Mercedes was great. Got through the training no problem. My guy is in great condition and glad to be home

Mercedes did private lessons with my 2 dogs and it was a great experience! It was very hands on and she taught me the proper techniques to train my dogs! She gave me all the tools to work through at home but I will also attend group class to continue their training with them! Would 100% recommend Tip Top K9 to any dog owner!! Thank you so much!!

Kris and Mercedes are wonderful and have changed our lives significantly.  We have a mini dachshund that was aggressive with strangers and a pug that never listened.  We had tried other training programs before, but had little success.  Kris was very convincing in his first interaction with our doxie, so we decided to put him in a two week boarding training program.  He came back to us a totally different pup!  And working with Mercedes in private lessons afterward has reinforced his training and also trained our pug.  We used to be terrified to leave the house with our dogs and now we have two well behaved pups that we can take anywhere and even walk without leashes.  Dog training in general can be really expensive and it's tough to know where to spend your money.  This crew is well worth the money.  They're awesome people and amazing with dogs.  They definitely know what they're doing!

K9 Tip Top Dallas Dog Training is outstanding! The trainers are professional, patient, and truly care about dogs. They quickly understood my dog’s behavior and created a customized plan that worked wonders.
Within weeks, I saw major improvements in obedience and leash manners. They also taught me how to maintain consistent training at home. Highly recommend for real, lasting results! 🐶💯
amazing job training my new pup. 10/10 recommendation
Tip top K9 has awesome trainers. They really focus on making sure you understand what they are teaching you and are patient through the process. I recommend them to anyone looking to train their dog.
I love this training program. I am now sending my second dog through and again I am very pleased with the results.

Tip Top K9 has amazing trainers! They come to your home and work with you and your dog along with their well trained dog. They are so good at what they do, so knowledgeable and passionate about training dogs. After our lessons were over we have continued training for the life of our dog, Moonshine! It’s a great refresher lesson to brush up on what we’ve learned/forgotten! Before training I could not take my dog out in public, she overreacted when she saw other dogs. Now with the help of Tip Top K 9 trainers we can go places and enjoy going on walks with Moonshine!

Kris was great with our dog, Bindi, from the beginning to the welcome home.  Bindi learned, come, stay, place, heel, off.  At the end of Bindis training, it was time for Kris to train my husband and me.   Tip Top K9 brought Bindi home to our house and trained us how to follow through with how Bindi was trained.  Tip Top K9 makes the whole process from beginning to end work so smoothly.  You can also call anytime when have questions.

Tip Top has changed my life!! I have a reactive dachshund whose reactivity got worse once we moved. Tip Top was the only trainer I consulted with who actually showed me results AND offered a guarantee or my $ back. I was immediately sold and have been on a training journey with Mercedes and have nothing but the best to say about Tip Top. The training programs are so thorough, effective, and designed to teach you, the owner, the best tips for success. Mercedes has been a joy to work with and has taught my dog so much in just a few lessons. I am so glad I found Tip Top and would highly recommend them to anyone in the Dallas area!!

My trainer, Kris, was amazing, working with our stubborn, tending towards aggressive dog and teaching me how to control him in a positive way. We made so much progress in just a month and look forward to attending the group classes and continuing to work on our own to have a better behaved dog that lets us have more fun together!

Mark and his team are fantastic and have worked hard to successfully train our fur babies. Having well trained dogs will change our lives and set us up for much happier days ahead. Highly recommend Tip Top K-9 and their crew of trainers.
BEST EXPERIENCE. DOGS ARE SO MUCH BETTER!!
Great folks my puppies after their boot camp 4 weeks long what a difference awesome training A+ in my book
Excellent results. Trainers are competent and very nice. It is worth the time.

We can’t thank Jeremy enough for the work he did with our 2-year-old pit bull/Catahoula mix! Before training, our pup struggled with impulse control, leash pulling, and constant jumping. Jeremy approached each issue with patience, structure, and incredible skill.

Not only did he help our dog learn how to walk calmly on a leash and greet people politely, but he also gave us the tools to continue reinforcing good behavior at home. The transformation has been amazing — our dog is so much more balanced, responsive, and enjoyable to be around.

Jeremy is the real deal — professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about what he does. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and how to bring out their best.

We did the hybrid class option with our two small dogs (~15lbs) and they did GREAT! They stayed with the trainers for about a week and a half and then did weekly visits to our home. Having the home lessons really helped. We had tried other group lessons and our dogs were great…until we got home. It was clear they associated training with the training location. We just had a baby and needed some extra help getting them prepared for our new arrival. The trainers, Mercedes and Jeremey were awesome and able to cater to helping us with baby specific training, such as loose leash walking with the stroller and quiet during nap time. By the end of our training they were even able to ignore other excited dogs walking while we walked with the stroller!

I was initially very hesitant to use e-collars, especially because my boys are so small, but the trainers (1) have high quality collars for all different sizes of dogs (2) had us test them out first so we understood what it felt like and (3) helped introduce them to the dogs so they know it’s a training tool and not a punishment. Given that they are always happy to see the trainers when they come for our home lessons and not afraid, it’s clear that the dogs understand the ecollars are a training tool to and not a punishment. Would highly recommend Tip Top for your training needs!
Jeremy was great! On the first lesson I told him he was crazy and our dog wouldn’t do that but now after our session, he does that!!
Could not recommend Jeremy or the training program more! Our reactive dog made strides quickly and has built up a lot more confidence with consistent training around other dogs.
Excellent training!  Jeremy was very attentive and patient with Rex and us!!  Rex seemed happy and content when he came home.
Jeremy did a great job with my reactive pet.
We had an awesome experience start to finish. Mercedes spent a ton of time training us, and she was so patient!
They really care about your dog and want you to learn just as much as your dog does. Rex is definitely a better pup because of this amazing training. We love them!
Did the 11 at home training, Jeremy did  awesome with our 10 months old Shepherd. Definitely worth the time and money. Totally different dog than when we started. Thank you!
Thanks for the 5-stars Paige! Happy to hear that we have met your expectations :)
Great job with very reactive dogs. Great explanation of steps and commands!

My husband & I took 6 private lessons with Jeremy for our 6 year old Aussie/German Shepherd mix, Lilly. Over the last few years Lilly has been very skiddish towards other animals & children which caused us to keep her sheltered away inside our home from any possible triggers. We were always on edge if she had to go somewhere where other animals or children might be around afraid that she might bite or attack them. One week while my husband & I were out of town our worst fears happened & Lilly bit a child in our family while my mom was dog sitting for us. We knew we needed to do something to be more in control of Lilly to prevent anything like this from ever happening again. That’s when we found Tip Top K9. I was worried about the idea of putting an older dog through training & worried if it would be worth the high cost associated with the training but we decided to go through with it as we felt we were running out of options. Knowing what I know now - I wish we would have done this training so much sooner. Jeremy was extremely knowledgeable & an amazing trainer for Lilly. I am so thankful for all he taught her & us. I was able to take Lilly to PetSmart, Home Depot, & even to lunch with me & keep her attention away from all the distractions. I have so much more confidence in being able to control her & her being able to control herself. I would recommend this training to any and all dog owners everywhere.
